verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an illegible speck in the card's top-left corner, so the brand is effectively lost. Its eyebrow sits off-axis to the right of the headline, and the bottom row breaks body copy, CTA and tiny unreadable legal text into three separate pieces that don't line up. B keeps the original's centred stack: logo at proper size, then eyebrow, a single-line headline, body copy, a prominent CTA and subordinate legal text, all with clear hierarchy. Its only minor flaws are that the card sits close to the bottom edge and the headline is a bit less dominant on one line.
